- A card the customer found again was not closed.
- For each closed card, one of these is true: a replacement was ordered to the confirmed address (on file or alternate) with the correct tier fees and timeframe; the customer declined one; or the customer was told when one can be ordered (the Entry 48-hour wait, including after accepting the excess fee; or the tier limit, with the age-out date when the customer chose to wait).
